data_quality.note: 129 of 1284 historical constituents have no yfinance price history (delisted or acquired names, plus identifiers yfinance does not resolve — e.g. AAN, AAXN, ACOR, ADEAV, AGTI, AKRX, AMBC, AMEH). They are dropped from both numerator and denominator, which biases breadth toward survivors until a delisted-price source is integrated. Daily n_with_price vs n_constituents lets Step 3 quarantine suspect periods.
